children: Many early investors in Anthropic are set to reap massive windfalls as the AI company makes its Nasdaq debut on Thursday. Sam Bankman-Fried, the convicted founder of the now-defunct crypto exchange FTX, isn't one of them.

In April 2022, Anthropic announced a $580 million Series B round led by Bankman-Fried, who is now serving a 25-year prison sentence. Caroline Ellison, former CEO of FTX's sister trading firm Alameda Research, and Nishad Singh, an FTX co-founder and its former director of engineering, also participated in the round, Anthropic said.

After the collapse of FTX in late 2022, the FTX bankruptcy estate sold its $500 million stake in Anthropic in 2024 for about $1.3 billion to help repay creditors. At Anthropic's $83-a-share IPO price, that stake would be worth roughly $37 billion today.
